# Bleuprint

> Bleuprint LLC is a Michigan brand strategy and marketing consultancy for small, owner-run businesses across metro Detroit and mid-Michigan. Every engagement starts with a $199 diagnosis that finds the one thing actually blocking growth and turns it into a 30-day plan.

Founder: Kalena Waters Gardner
Service area: Detroit, Southfield, Royal Oak, Ferndale, Birmingham, Bloomfield Hills, Troy, Auburn Hills, Farmington Hills, Novi, Flint, Grand Blanc, Fenton, Flushing, Davison, Michigan
Who it's for: med spas, hair and nail salons, lash and brow studios, barbershops, dental and orthodontic practices, car dealerships and auto service shops, furniture and home stores, cafes and restaurants, boutique fitness studios, boutiques and local retail

## Services
Content strategy, content calendars, brand development, brand guides, creative direction, social content filming and editing, podcast production, competitor and market research, CRM and Meta pixel tracking setup, PR kits, event planning, website strategy and build support, website management.
